scope: Original 2023 English Uprising v23-10-12; standard 2–4-player multiplayer, required scoring Rival for two humans, optional standard base-box CHOAM with 20 standard contracts; identify but exclude 10 Rise of Ix compatibility contracts; apply relevant general/Uprising January 13, 2025 official FAQ. Excludes solo, optional Rival variants including Streamlined, six-player teams, cross-game expansions, and later-product components.
conclusion: No material incorrect claim or important omission found within the authorized scope. Printed card effects remain governed by their cards; no unsupported card details were inferred.

checked_claims.subject: Components, player supplies, starting decks, 20 standard plus 10 compatibility contracts
checked_claims.result: Consistent; distinction between standard and compatibility contract sets is explicit.

checked_claims.subject: Board setup, Conflict deck composition and order, Leader selection, card states, Objectives, starting resources and markers
checked_claims.result: Consistent, including 1/5/4 Conflict composition, face-down decks, five face-up Row cards, human Hooks initially in bank and nine supply troops.

checked_claims.subject: Round order, Round Start, Player Turn eligibility, resource payment timing, plot timing and two-player continuation
checked_claims.result: Consistent. Pre-entry Plot resources may pay entry; space/card gains after placement cannot.

checked_claims.subject: Card anatomy, Agent access, Faction advance and effect ordering
checked_claims.result: Consistent; Spy Agent access, normal matching icons, occupancy bypass and Influence advances are correctly distinguished.

checked_claims.subject: Reveal effects, acquisition timing, strength calculation and cleanup
checked_claims.result: Consistent, including flexibility to set/update strength while resolving Reveal effects.

checked_claims.subject: Combat participation, sequential intrigue passes, changing strength, rewards by player count, ties and cleanup
checked_claims.result: Consistent: no untied third reward with two humans plus Rival, no winner/card on first-place tie, troops return to supply, worms to bank.

checked_claims.subject: Makers, Recall, Endgame trigger, VP movement and ordered tiebreakers
checked_claims.result: Consistent; final Reveal-turn tiebreaker is supplied in FAQ section.

checked_claims.subject: Recruitment, legal troop origins, deployment limits, sandworm immediate deployment, Hooks and Shield Wall protection
checked_claims.result: Consistent; all troops newly recruited that turn may deploy at Combat spaces, plus up to two old garrison troops; Hooks are retained and are not a universal prerequisite.

checked_claims.subject: Battle icons, compulsory matching pairs and Endgame wild match
checked_claims.result: Consistent; neither battle icons nor location control doubles with sandworms.

checked_claims.subject: Faction Influence, retained track bonuses, Alliance transfer, loss and VP reversal
checked_claims.result: Consistent; tied challenger does not take token by gaining to tie, but holder losing Influence can cause transfer.

checked_claims.subject: Spies, observation posts, optional placement/recall, Infiltrate and Gather Intelligence timing and limits
checked_claims.result: Consistent; cannot bypass own Agent, and cannot gather twice from one placement.

checked_claims.subject: Critical location control, visitor/controller effects, defensive troop and permanent Wall removal
checked_claims.result: Consistent; defensive troop comes from supply and controller receives bonus even on another player’s visit.

checked_claims.subject: Mandatory and optional effects, arrow limits, trashing, discard origins, Intrigue types and destinations, drawn-card timing
checked_claims.result: Consistent; distinguishes ordinary optional arrows from mandatory Intrigue costs and documents all applicable general draw timing.

checked_claims.subject: Base-box Leader clarifications and CHOAM Leader FAQ
checked_claims.result: Consistent; Shaddam restriction starts immediately and lasts only the triggering turn.

checked_claims.subject: CHOAM setup, contracts taken/replenished, fallback Solari, completion conditions/timing, retained completed contracts and mandatory multiple completion
checked_claims.result: Consistent, including required ownership when Agent is sent and distinct 10 Rise of Ix contracts.

checked_claims.subject: All 22 standard board spaces: access icons, Combat flags, costs, requirements and effects
checked_claims.result: Every row independently compared. Accept Contract, Arrakeen, Assembly Hall, Deep Desert, Deliver Supplies, Desert Tactics, Dutiful Service, Espionage, Fremkit, Gather Support, Hagga Basin, Heighliner, High Council, Imperial Basin, Imperial Privilege, Research Station, Sardaukar, Secrets, Shipping, Sietch Tabr, Spice Refinery and Swordmaster all agree.

checked_claims.subject: Required two-player scoring Rival selection, setup, Objective and turn order
checked_claims.result: Consistent; optional Streamlined-only Rivals excluded and First Player alternates between humans.

checked_claims.subject: Rival Hagal placement legality, two-destination priority, Place Spy continuation and revealed effects
checked_claims.result: Consistent; normal board costs/effects ignored, and occupied condition-selected destination does not permit use of alternative.

checked_claims.subject: Rival Spies, Schemes, troop origins/deployment and Maker/Wall behavior
checked_claims.result: Consistent; third Spy remains, other two return, Scheme troops before a Combat-space Agent visit deploy that turn.

checked_claims.subject: Rival resource priority, Swordmaster threshold, resource-to-VP conversion and Influence bonuses
source_references: supplements PDF page 5 Buying Victory Points diagram
checked_claims.result: Consistent. Diagram visually confirms 7 Solari, 7 spice, 3 Intrigues or 3 water per VP after Swordmaster; no 4-Influence track bonus.

checked_claims.subject: Rival Combat bonus timing, placement rewards, doubling, battle icons, control, Influence choices and contracts
checked_claims.result: Consistent; bottom Hagal swords only, normal reward/tie rules, least-Influence Faction with printed priority tie break, and contract reward becomes 2 Solari.

independence_statement: I am a fresh independent final source auditor. I read only the exact frozen iteration-07 summary and authorized authoritative text/PDF assets, plus its unannotated source diagram. I did not read another summary version, prior audit/reviewer conclusions, repair history, coverage questions/key, reader answers or grades; did not communicate with readers; did not assume PASS; and did not edit the summary. Findings and verdict were formed by direct comparison against these sources.
